title: Hoshino Ichika — Our New Song's Goal〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After School
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'd like to talk about selling tickets before we start practice today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, you have the floor.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Like I mentioned following our last show, the owner and manager have been giving us a free pass until this point. Starting next time, we'll have to start doing this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll need to find people who might be interested in seeing us perform and sell them tickets, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. If we're serious about going pro, this is something we'll have to do eventually.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we can sell them to anyone, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Usually, everyone starts with their friends or family, and work their way out from there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Friends of friends can help too.
Also, anyone you know from work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we'll need to sell thirty in total, which is at least seven a piece amongst the four of us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, we break even when we sell all of them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have to pay for any that we don't sell, so be sure to keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but seven seems pretty doable, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It should be and I'm sure you'll find people who are interested. Unfortunately, not everyone will be able to make it or pay for these if they don't have a source of income.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that's right... Minori and Kiritani mentioned that they'd like to see our show...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But haven't been able to because of their stream schedule.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's so rough. They can't go even if they really want to...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And it might be tough to get everyone to come back a second or even third time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not everyone has that much free time or the money to come to these things. Interest alone won't be enough.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I suppose it won't...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That means we have to make it so they want to come back and see us again by actually buying another ticket.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. In other words, we'd be establishing our fan base.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! Our own fans!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But if we develop a core group of fans, it'll make selling tickets just that much easier. And we'll need to keep practicing in order to accomplish that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, if we're serious about going pro, we should be striving towards gathering as many people as we can in as big a venue as possible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we just have to keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm guessing Iori and STANDOUT had to do what we're doing now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, they did.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So we just need to keep at it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We're gonna get a bunch of fans and make our big debut♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's easier said than done.
A lot easier...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We'll be fine. I mean, our second song gave us so much more trouble than our first one, so I think we're starting to understand what we're up against.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree. We're getting a good idea of what to prepare for now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, you two.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you thanking us?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nevermind. Ignore that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, we're gonna need to keep practicing the same way we have until now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And start selling tickets on top of that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know it won't be easy, but I think we can handle it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, as long as we're together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! I'm so fired up now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I think that should be enough for now in terms of tickets.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sounds good!
Shall we go practice?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's go.
